reason: A Cordis plugin that adds an Archived sessions navigation panel to the dsh Web GUI, allowing users to filter and restore archived sessions through local runtime APIs.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web GUI 添加归档会话导航面板，支持筛选归档会话并将其恢复到原工作区位置。
summaries.en: Adds an Archived sessions panel to the dsh Web GUI for filtering archived sessions and restoring them to their original workspace positions.

capabilities: Adds an Archived sessions button and popover to the dsh Web GUI
Lists archived sessions with title filtering
Restores archived sessions to their original workspace positions
Reads and persists workspace archive state through runtime service methods
Registers local HTTP routes for listing and restoring sessions
